title: "Associate CD15 Count with Epithelial Lesion Size"
output: pdf_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = '..')
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
source("R/data.R")
```

## Analysis 1: Combined regions per biopsy

Combine intact/ulcer epithelial regions within each biopsy, treating each ulcer as independent (ignoring ptid/slide/ulcer structure).

```{r combined-regions}
a <- "CD15"

all.res <- NULL
for (biopsy in biopsies) {

  slides <- slides.by.biopsy[[biopsy]]

  res <- mysapply(slides, function(s) {

    if (!is.null(cell_dat[[s]][[a]])) {

      size.ulcer.epi <- sum(subset(tissue_size, biopsy == s & region == 'ulcerative' & dist_type == 'dist2DEJ' & depth < 0)$area)

      cell.ulcer.epi <- nrow(subset(cell_dat[[s]][[a]], region == 'ulcerative' & epi))

      c(cell_count = cell.ulcer.epi, size = size.ulcer.epi)

    } else {
      c(0, 0)
    }

  })

  all.res <- rbind(all.res, res)
}

all.res <- all.res[all.res[, 'size'] > 0, ]
knitr::kable(all.res)
```

```{r plot-combined}
corplot(cell_count ~ size, all.res, add.diagonal.line = FALSE, log = "xy")
```

## Analysis 2: Each region as a separate observation

Treat each intact/ulcer region individually using region-level size data.

```{r per-region}
a <- "CD15"

tissue_size_2 <- read.csv(paste0(data.dir, "/tissue_size_by_depth_and_region_2.csv"))
tissue_size_2$biopsy <- get.slide.name(tissue_size_2$biopsy)

all.res <- NULL
for (biopsy in biopsies) {

  slides <- slides.by.biopsy[[biopsy]]

  res <- lapply(slides, function(s) {

    # myprint(s)

    if (!is.null(cell_dat[[s]][[a]])) {

      size.ulcer.epi <- subset(tissue_size_2, biopsy == s & region == 'ulcerative' & dist_type == 'dist2DEJ' & depth < 0)

      if (nrow(size.ulcer.epi) > 0) {
        size.ulcer.epi <- aggregate(area ~ region_id, size.ulcer.epi, sum)

        cell.ulcer.epi <- subset(cell_dat[[s]][[a]], region == 'ulcerative' & epi)

        sapply(1:nrow(size.ulcer.epi), function(i) {
          region_id <- size.ulcer.epi[i, "region_id"]
          col_id <- grep(glue("epi_region_{region_id}_lesion"), colnames(cell.ulcer.epi))
          c(cell_count = sum(cell.ulcer.epi[[col_id]] == "True"), size = size.ulcer.epi[i, "area"])
        })
      }

    }

  })
  res <- res[sapply(res, function(x) !is.null(x))]

  if (len(res) > 0) {
    tmp <- do.call(cbind, res)
    colnames(tmp) <- names(res) %.% (1:ncol(tmp))

    all.res <- rbind(all.res, t(tmp))
  }
}

knitr::kable(all.res)
```

```{r plot-per-region}
corplot(cell_count ~ size, all.res, add.diagonal.line = FALSE, log = "xy")
```
